description.value: 852 Kitchen is a multi-location Hong Kong-style food shop specializing in handcrafted dim sum, home-style dishes, nourishing soups, frozen dumplings, and signature pineapple buns, all prepared in a commercial kitchen in Richmond. The Joyce Street Vancouver branch is one of four locations across Metro Vancouver. Products are designed for pickup or delivery, making it a convenient stop for cyclists seeking authentic Cantonese and Hong Kong flavors.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (8 spaces) at 51m. Total: 8 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and confirms the business name, phone (604-999-1199), address (4963 Joyce Street, Vancouver, BC), and email, all matching OSM tags.
